describes: packages/plugin/stamp: library and asset edits, marks, registered libraries, previews, placement without the pointer, and the change events.

cases.name: create-update-and-delete-libraries
cases.covers: createLibrary writes a blank seed's /Title and catalog PieceInfo and keeps the saved bytes; a preferred id is kept unless taken; kind and categories ride along. updateLibrary rewrites the title only when the name changes and the PieceInfo always; an unknown id rejects NotFound. exportLibrary copies the canonical bytes or rejects not-found. The library events and the change signal fire for each; filtered reads select by one kind or several.

cases.name: library-writes-that-fail
cases.covers: A library whose save answered nothing has no canonical bytes: updating it or one of its assets rejects Unknown. A raster whose size is not positive rejects InvalidArg. A seed without named pages rejects NotImplemented before any write, and a failed save rejects after the close, adding nothing.

cases.name: import-a-registered-library
cases.covers: A library whose /Names /Pages registry names its pages imports those keys as identifier and label, in page order whatever the key order; its /Title names it, its catalog kind and locale read back; a registration that is not a page is ignored with a warning; nothing is registered again.

args: [stamp] library 'Goedkeuringen' carries 1 hidden-template or dangling registration(s); they are not stamps and were ignored

cases.name: registry-refusals
cases.covers: A registry key with an empty identifier or a repeated one rejects InvalidArg naming it; an engine that reports no registry at all rejects NotImplemented; a library kind the plugin does not define is kept as written.

cases.name: marks-become-assets
cases.covers: createAsset authors an ink mark (its box padded by the stroke, the colour parsed) or a typed one (a generous box, the default colour) on a scratch page and exports its appearance as the asset's page; an image mark is a raster; a PDF mark is used whole, or one page of it extracted. Without a name the identifier is minted Acrobat-style from Math.random, and the label defaults to it.

cases.name: marks-that-are-refused
cases.covers: Both a source and a mark, or neither, reject InvalidArg; a colour that is not #rrggbb and an ink mark with no points reject InvalidArg after the scratch document closes; a PDF mark's missing page rejects InvalidArg naming the page count. An identifier that is empty or holds '=' rejects InvalidArg.

cases.name: edit-move-and-copy-assets
cases.covers: updateAsset renames the registry entry only when the label changes, rewrites the page PieceInfo, and clears the subject for null; an unknown asset rejects NotFound. duplicateAsset appends a copy of the page with a minted identifier and a ' copy' label (or the one given); moveAsset copies into another library and removes the original, returns the id itself for the same library, and rejects not-found for an unknown asset, as duplicateAsset does. A second asset of the same name rejects InvalidArg.

cases.name: raster-pages-that-fail
cases.covers: A raster page whose flatten does not apply rejects Unknown, and an asset engine without pages.flatten rejects NotImplemented; both close the library copy and add nothing.

cases.name: an-asset-from-annotations
cases.covers: createAssetFromAnnotations exports the selected annotations' appearance from the open document as the source of a new asset; a document that is not open rejects NotFound.

cases.name: rendered-previews
cases.covers: renderAssetPreview opens the asset's page bytes, renders its first page at the width asked and closes, caching the render per width; a render that fails is reported and falls back to the cached thumbnail; a copy with no pages answers null; an unknown asset rejects not-found. Removing the asset drops its renders.

args: [stamp] ghost render failed, using the thumbnail:

cases.name: place-without-the-pointer
cases.covers: placeAsset hands the target's annotation plugin the asset's payload and the placement and answers the placed annotation's ref; an unknown asset rejects NotFound. placeAssetOnPages places on every page or the ones listed, reporting each failure by its page as a stamp PluginError.

cases.name: the-armed-asset
cases.covers: getArmedAsset answers the asset this plugin armed while the annotation plugin still holds a stamp, and null once a tool change dropped it or nothing was armed; disarm announces a change only when something was armed. canPlace follows the target's annotation create grant, the active document when none is named; canImport is optimistic.

cases.name: can-place-without-a-document
cases.covers: canPlace with no document named and none active answers false.

cases.name: restore-stored-libraries
cases.covers: restoreStampLibraries imports every stored library as it is and answers their ids; one that fails to import is reported and skipped. A store whose list rejects rejects the restore.

args: [stamp] stored library 'junk' could not be restored:

$error.name: EngineError
$error.message: [stamp] importLibraryPdf needs PDF bytes (use addAsset for a raster image)

cases.name: a-store-that-cannot-list
cases.covers: A store whose list rejects rejects the restore with that error.

cases.name: persist-library-changes
cases.covers: persistStampLibraries writes a library's exported PDF to the store once its changes stop for the debounce, a burst coalescing into one write; a removal deletes the stored copy at once and drops a pending write; an excepted library is never stored. The stop function unsubscribes and flushes pending writes immediately.

cases.name: persistence-failures-are-reported
cases.covers: A store write or delete that rejects is reported with the library id and leaves the stream running; the default debounce is 250 ms.
